title: One native app, five places
subtitle: Proposed adaptation map · source-derived parity, not an app screenshot

items.title: Today → About you → Decide
items.body: Answer a question, inspect the supporting answer, then use relevant evidence in a comparison.

items.title: Tools + Account
items.body: Earlier learning, circles and outcome patterns stay available. Privacy, export and deletion remain easy to find.

items.title: Local draft ≠ saved answer
items.body: Keep drafts through poor networks; confirm account writes only after the server. Never silently replay a stale privacy generation.

items.title: Permissions after a reason
items.body: Share on request. No first-launch permission wall. Native push is a separate integration and device-verification gate.

title: Make the evidence understandable
subtitle: Research synthesis · expected benefits are hypotheses, not measured retention

items.title: Easy to answer, easy to skip
items.body: Large equal answer targets, visible neutral/skip choices, and context before any unfamiliar comparison.

items.title: One task, details on request
items.body: Keep the question prominent; open meanings, criteria and source answers through labeled controls.

items.title: No personality from one tap
items.body: A surprising answer can mean humor, context or time pressure. Show a limited reflection and let the person correct it.

items.title: Curiosity without pressure
items.body: Question variety and a useful ending; no guilt streaks, fake social proof, random unlocks or forced disclosure.

title: Test understanding, not just attraction
subtitle: Proposed six-participant study · no participant findings claimed

items.title: Three provisional jobs
items.body: Try a useful preview. Compare a real choice without guessing. Correct what Nudge has learned.

items.title: Tasks with failure paths
items.body: Change topic, explain a reflection's source, compare unfamiliar terms, recover a lost connection, find export and deletion.

items.title: Include access needs
items.body: Recruit across Android sizes, large-text use and assistive technology. Observe task behavior separately from interpretation.

items.title: Measure honest value
items.body: Completion, errors, source comprehension, uncertainty and perceived pressure. Voluntary Finish is a successful exit.

title: Three structures, one Nudge identity
subtitle: Design proposals · Clear question selected under the owner's approval to proceed

items.title: A · Clear question — selected
items.body: One prompt, generous answer rows, a small evidence fold. Best fit for first use and one-handed answering.

items.title: B · Field notes
items.body: Chronological answers, reflections and revisions. Strong audit trail; risks feeling dense before Nudge knows enough.

items.title: C · Connections
items.body: Pair an answer with the reflection and decision context it supports. Strong explanation; avoid an empty decorative graph.

items.title: Keep the mark and blue
items.body: Same Nudge logo and palette. Borrow revision clarity and source links without cream/terracotta, acid accents or generic dashboards.

directions.name: Clear question
directions.layout: One question, full-width answer rows, clear Continue and optional evidence fold.

directions.name: Field notes
directions.layout: Dated question-answer-reflection blocks with visible corrections and readable controls.

directions.name: Connections
directions.layout: Paired source and applicability panels, never a personality score or decorative knowledge graph.

title: A checked palette, meaningful controls
subtitle: Calculated from current source colors · rendered accessibility still needs device checks

items.title: Light and dark checked separately
items.body: Primary text: 11.33:1 light, 13.75:1 dark on screen. Secondary text: 5.38:1 and 9.51:1.

items.title: Reference → role → component
items.body: Keep the exact blue brand, document OKLCH equivalents, and make components use semantic tokens.

items.title: Control boundaries matter
items.body: Faint separator colors are decorative. Inputs use controlLine; selected answers add a checkmark and announced state.

items.title: Readable and reachable
items.body: 16-unit base body size with system scaling, 48dp Android touch targets and at least 8dp separation. No color-only status.

title: A question before a wall of text
subtitle: Screen and copy specification · proposals, not rendered app screens

items.title: Today
items.body: Question → full answer rows → Skip / Continue. Change topic is visible. After saving: Answer another or Finish for now.

items.title: Three real action buttons
items.body: Have a decision in mind? · Open your journal · Question preferences. Full targets and native pressed states.

items.title: Decide in clear steps
items.body: Options → only the missing context → review → result with evidence and unknowns. Unfamiliar terms trigger clarification.

items.title: Every state has a next action
items.body: Empty, loading, error, offline and long-content behavior specified. Saved-but-refresh-failed never becomes a duplicate save.

title: Feedback that explains what changed
subtitle: Motion targets · timing and frame rates are not yet measured

items.title: Press first, confirm honestly
items.body: 100ms pressed-feedback target. Pending appears immediately; Saved waits for the server.

items.title: The evidence fold
items.body: Open the exact source answer behind a reflection. A small 180ms opacity transition supports meaning, not decoration.

items.title: Sparse haptics
items.body: Optional selection tick and confirmed-save feedback. No vibration on scroll and no error shame.

items.title: Reduced motion everywhere
items.body: Remove movement, use a short fade or immediate state. Back, Close and visible action menus replace gesture-only paths.

title: Known checks and open proof
subtitle: Audit boundary · a source review is not a perfect-app certification

items.title: Known from source and calculation
items.body: Shared native tokens, selected-state primitives, separate topic Apply, privacy-aware contracts and checked opaque color pairs.

items.title: Device checks still required
items.body: TalkBack, largest text, small/landscape/tablet layout, touch gaps, focus return and reduced-motion behavior.

items.title: Three priority fixes
items.body: Complete real route parity. Validate failure recovery in the latest APK. Test whether people understand reflection evidence and limits.

items.title: Keep claims bounded
items.body: No invented participant findings, measured speed, native push delivery or public-release readiness.

title: Build from explicit contracts
subtitle: Developer handoff · native parity and evidence gates, not a second product

items.title: Screen → component → API
items.body: Each screen maps to real discovery, decision, account or tools contracts and complete UI states.

items.title: Identity stays pinned
items.body: Keep user, privacy generation, revision and intent body through pending writes. Review again after conflicts; never rebase silently.

items.title: Responsive by behavior
items.body: Wrap real content, preserve font scaling and logical RTL spacing, virtualize long lists and keep actions above safe areas.

items.title: Evidence before delivery claims
items.body: Rebuild and install the latest APK, exercise real journeys, capture screenshots and record remaining AI, push and store gates.
